files.delta: retain current-main workflow; add DC-L01 lint and unittest discovery; capture verbose DevControl output in the existing failed-test artifact
describe only DC-L01 authority, Landlock ABI 3+ plus seccomp filesystem confinement, hidden-index handling and explicit exclusions
remove future cryptography dependency and pin the build backend for the foundation
export only modules and symbols landed in DC-L01
retain only validate-task and check-paths; remove later physical/catalog commands

replace process-group-only and DC-L05 Windows imports with a Linux subreaper supervisor that kills descendants escaping into new sessions; require its positive quiescence acknowledgement before emitting termination proof; fail closed on Windows until DC-L05

freeze command argv; reject non-canonical raw cwd authority before PurePosixPath normalization; verify exact task HEAD and clean source state; execute each command in a bounded independent exact-HEAD Git repository created through a temporary bundle; remove the origin and bundle before execution; use no object alternates; isolate HOME/XDG/TMP/Git configuration; reject source-path disclosure and Git-context overrides; require Linux Landlock ABI 3+ and grant persistent write/create/delete/truncate/refer rights only below the disposable sandbox root, with /dev/null as the sole non-persistent sink; install an inherited architecture-checked seccomp filter that denies chmod, chown, legacy and at-variant xattr, file-attribute and timestamp mutation syscall families not mediated by Landlock, rejects the x86_64 x32 syscall namespace and denies io_uring setup/entry/registration to prevent alternate metadata dispatch; fingerprint sandbox worktree plus full bounded Git metadata; destroy the sandbox and re-verify the source repository before issuing evidence
reject empty, dot and parent raw path segments before PurePosixPath can normalize ambiguous task authority

verify workspace HEAD equals the task base SHA; reject and verified-reset staged, unstaged, untracked, ignored, assume-unchanged and skip-worktree pre-apply state before git apply; explicitly clear hidden index flags before hard reset; include ignored artifacts and hidden flags in post-apply cleanliness evidence; reset staged, untracked, ignored and nested Git state with git clean -ffdx; verify physical clean state before returning no receipt

replace DC-L09 TrustedGitRunner import with an implementation-free WorkspaceGitRunner protocol; retain exact-SHA local worktree behavior; sanitize inherited GIT_* variables from generic subprocess execution

remove deferred DC-L09 runner import; prove Linux subreaper containment and negative acknowledgement behavior; execute observable direct nested-repository and Git config/hook sandbox mutations compatible with the seccomp boundary; cover oversized snapshot reset, forbidden template Git environment and inherited GIT_DIR sanitization

replace future TrustedGitRunner dependency; add empty-registry and future/product-import assertions plus executable regressions for ignored-artifact disposal, immutable argv, exact command/patch HEAD binding, hidden patch artifacts, pre-staged command rejection, pre-staged patch rejection before any git apply call, ambiguous raw task paths and ambiguous raw command cwd; remove the obsolete source-string assertion for the superseded command reset implementation

add task construction for injected command ids and executable independent-sandbox regressions proving no source workspace, backup metadata, bundle, remote or object alternate is exposed; prove sandbox-only Git metadata mutations invalidate evidence while source config, hooks and status remain unchanged; prove descendant absolute writes plus chmod, chown, xattr and timestamp mutations outside the sandbox are denied; exercise raw io_uring, setxattrat/removexattrat/file_setattr, ioctl and x86_64 x32 syscall aliases and require EPERM before kernel argument handling; prove assume-unchanged and skip-worktree patch state is rejected, cleared and restored
prove the explicit DC-L01 unittest discovery reaches all three foundation tests
